scheme_name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Parityakta Pension Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be an abandoned woman
Applicant's name must be mentioned on the Samagr portal
benefits_summary: Provides a pension of ₹600 per month to eligible women.
application_link: Step 1: Go to the Samajik Suraksha portal. Step 2: Click on Samajik Suraksha pension avm arthik sahayata yojanaen. Step 3: Now click on the left on your screen Pension Yojana hetu online aavedan. Step 4: Fill in the required details and submit.
